paite: Mite a khopi dim sek, bangchidan a lungzuang a tu maimah ahia! Bangchidan a meithai bang a hong om maimah ahia! Namte lak a thupi sek a, bialte lak a lalnu sek, bangchidan a sikha suak maimah ahia!
heading: Jerusalem Lungkhamnate
english: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become tributary!

paite: Zan in nakpitak in akap a, abiang a khituite toh; a-itte tengteng lak ah amah nem ding kuamah anei kei a; alawmte tengteng atung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua, amelmate ahong hi uhi.
english: She weeps bitterly in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they are become her enemies.

paite: Gimthuakna ziak leh, saltanna thupi ziak in saltanna ah Judah apaita hi; khovel mite lak ah ateng a, tawldamna amu kei; mun kochikte ah amah sawi tengteng in apha uhi.
english: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; she dwells among the nations, she finds no rest: all her persecutors overtook her within the straits.

paite: Kikhopna thupi a kuamah ahong pai louh ziak un. Zion lampite'n asuun ua; akongpite tengteng loih in a-om a, asiampute athum huthut uh; anungak siangthoute gimthuak in a-om ua, amah mah haksa thuak in a-om hi.
english: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly; all her gates are desolate, her priests do sigh: her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

paite: Agalte vaihawm makai ahong hi a, melmate alohching uh; atatlekna tam luat ziak in TOUPA'N lah amah gim athuaksak ngal a; melma ma ah ata tuailaite saltanna ah apai uh.
english: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper; for Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary.

paite: Zion tate a pan in kilawmna tengteng apaimangta; alalte loupa hing mu lou zuktalte bang ahi ua, delhmi ma ah hatna nei lou in apai uh.
english: From the daughter of Zion all her majesty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

paite: Agimthuak ni leh ahaksat ni in Jerusalem in nidanglai a kipan a om khinsa athil nuamte tengteng atheigige a; melma khut a mite apuk lai un, amah kuamah in apanpih kei, galte'n amah amu ua, asiatna ah anuihsan uhi.
english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her, The adversaries saw her, they mocked at her desolations.

paite: Nakpitak in Jerusalem in thil ahihkhial a; huaiziak in thilnin bang in ahong om hi; avuaktanna amuh ziak un, amah zahte'n amusit ua, ahi, anak huthut a, nunglam ah akiheita hi.
english: Jerusalem has grievously sinned; therefore she has become as an unclean thing; all who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.

paite: Anik ah anitna a-om a; abeina nanung atheigige kei; huaiziak in lamdangtak in ahong kun a; lungmuanmi anei kei hi; ngai in, Aw TOUPA, ka gimthuakna; melmapa akiliansak hi.
english: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she didn’t remember her latter end; therefore is she come down wonderfully; she has no comforter: see, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.

paite: Gal in amah nu gou manphate tengteng tung ah akhut azak a; amun siangthou sung ah khovel mi ahong lut chih amu ngal a, na kikhopna uah amau ahong lut louh ding uh ahi chi a thu na piak.
english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.

paite: Amite tengteng anak huhu ua, tanghou azong ua; kha hihhalh ding in athil nuamte uh sa khenna ding in apia ua: "Thei inla, Aw TOUPA, en in ka hong buah ziak in."
english: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul: look, Yahweh, and see; for I am become abject.

paite: Nou a ding a bangmah lou ahi maw, nou hon paisuaksante tengteng? Ngai unla, en un, ka tung a hih a om ka lungkhamna bang lungkhamna himhim a-om hiam? Aheh mahmah lai a TOUPA'N ahon hihgimna bang.
english: Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, With which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

paite: Tungsang a kipan in ka guhte ah mei ahon sawl a, amaute azou a; ka khe a ding in len azak a, ahon nungheisan; segawp leh nitum a bah in ahon bawlta hi.
english: From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them; He has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: He has made me desolate and faint all the day.

paite: Akhut a ka tatleknate hakkol khih in a-om a; phialkhawm in a-om ua, ka ngawngzang ah ahong tung ua; ka hatna avuaksuaksak; amau ka dou zohlouhte, akhut uah Toupa'n kei ahon pia hi.
english: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they have come up on my neck; he has made my strength to fail: The Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

paite: Ka lak a ka mihatte Toupa'n bangmah lou in a-omsak a; ka tangvalte mekgawpna ding in ka siatna ding in ama'n kikhawmpi poimoh asam a; uain sukna bang in Toupa'n Judah tanu siangthou asikdenta hi.
english: The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men in the midst of me; He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men: The Lord has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.

paite: Hiai thilte ziak in ka kap a; ka mit tui in atum a; lungmuan ding ka kha hihhalh ding kei a pan agamla ngal a; melma avualzoh ziak in, ka tate amau kia a nutsiat in a-om uhi.
english: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water; Because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.

paite: Zion in akhutte azakkhia a; amah lungmuan ding kuamah a-om kei uh; TOUPA'N Jakob tungthu ah thu apia a, huchi a akimvel a omte agalte ahong hihna ding un; Jerusalem alak uah thilnin bang in a-om hi.
english: Zion spreads forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries: Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

paite: TOUPA adiktat a; athupiak ka helsan ua; himahleh za un, ka hon ngen hi, nou mi tengtengte aw, ka lungkhamna en un; ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte saltanna ah apai uhi.
english: Yahweh is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow: My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

paite: Ka itte ka sam a, himahleh ahon khem uh; ka siampute leh ka upate'n amau khate hihhalh ding a an akizon lai un khopi sung ah asihloh uhi.
english: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ngai in; ka dah ua; ka lungsim amangbang a; ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a; nakpitak in ka helta ua; polam ah namsau thah in insung ah sihna a-om hi.
english: See, Yahweh; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled; My heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaves, at home there is as death.

paite: Ka thum aza ua; kuamah hon khamuan ding a-om kei; ka melmate tengteng in ka mangbatna aza ua, huchibang a na hih ziak in akipak uh; na phuankhiaksa ni na tun ding a, kei bang ahi ding uh.
english: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me; All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they shall be like me.

paite: Agitlouhna tengteng uh na ma ah hong tung hen; ka tatlekna tengteng ziak a ka tung a na hih bang in amaute tung ah leng hih in; ka khoisatna atam lua a, ka lungtang leng abahgawpta hi.
english: Let all their wickedness come before you; Do to them, as you have done to me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
